messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: ReservedCapacityHigh for tenant 'avalon-prod' (reserved-pool id: rp-07). Alert: p95 latency > 1200ms and 503 spikes. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty. Pager: PD-INC-90421
PagerDuty: PD alert created -> https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-INC-90421 (auto: trigger)
Olivia: acked on PagerDuty, jumping in. Seeing the same in console.
Sam (SRE): noticed a sudden increase in KV cache evictions on rp-07, eviction rate x10. Likely hot-prefix churn from a new rollout?
Tia (infra): pulling node metrics now. GPU utilization at 92%, queue length spiking, backlog hitting burst-queue threshold.
Leo (runbook): recs: 1) enable reserved pool burst (if not already), 2) route tenant to compatible fallback model variant, 3) clear small-kv prefixes for hotspot.
Olivia: running temporary mitigation: routing 'avalon-prod' to shared-fallback model variant (latency SLO worse but avoids 503). Command: `redwood route set --tenant avalon-prod --variant fallback-v2 --temp 15m`
Sam (SRE): running `kubectl exec -n serving rp-07-tooling -- ./kvctl evict --prefix avalon/hot --dry-run` to confirm. Logs show 87k prefix entries. Will do targeted evict.
Sam (SRE): evict started (non-blocking). Command: ```
kvctl evict --pool rp-07 --prefix avalon/hot-2026-03 --concurrency 4
```
Maria (CS): pinging Avalon support contact (cc: @account-team) to warn about possible degraded latency for 10-20 min.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-90421 acknowledged by Olivia. Escalation paused.
Tia (infra): I see evictions reducing mem pressure, queue depth dropping from 520 -> 120 over last 90s. GPU utl now 78%.
Olivia: good. rolling back routing change once backlog down. Sam, estimate time to stabilize?
Sam (SRE): if no new hotspot traffic, stabilized in ~5-10m. I'll keep eviction running for another 5m and then stop.
Leo (runbook): reminder: update `reserved-pool` autoscale policy after postmortem; current policy didn't allow quick add due to cooldown. We should file a follow-up.
Maria (CS): Avalon acknowledges, appreciates quick response. Asking for RCA and timeline for permanent fix. I'll schedule customer sync if we need to change config.
Olivia: agree. I'll keep PD incident open until metrics back to normal for 10m. Adding action items: (1) postmortem, (2) evaluate autoscale cooldown, (3) add hotspot detection alert to preempt evictions.
IncidentBot: note: runbook step executed: temporary-route-enabled, kv-evict-started.
Sam (SRE): eviction finished, queues stable, no 503s in last 90s. p95 latency back to ~320ms.
Olivia: confirming resolution, marking incident as mitigated. Leaving incident open for documented follow-ups.
PagerDuty: PD-INC-90421 status -> Resolved by Olivia at 4287654520.
Maria (CS): I'll draft customer note and coordinate postmortem timeline.
Olivia: thanks team. We'll capture timeline and root causes in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
